title: Inventory the documented platform and inspect the supplied starter before extending it
technology: DOCUMENTED: AI Native ODA Canvas operators on EKS, AgentConfig-managed AgentCore Runtime, ToolConfig-managed Lambda through AgentCore Gateway MCP, shared modaas-agw inference gateway and TMF639 registry. Runtime resources remain unexercised.
steps: Read the supplied ~/starter/register.yaml, evaluate.py, pull-evidence.sh, gap-list.md, run-ids.txt and submit.sh; record existing behavior and extension points before creating code.

Resolve actual team AgentConfig, ToolConfig and ModelConfig resources in oda.tmforum.org/v1beta1, including governed model alias fields, status.endpoint and TMF639 v5 inventory. Record each supplied agent/tool/scenario and gaps against the earlier three-zone drawing.
Keep AgentCore Gateway MCP/tool routing distinct from modaas-agw model inference and the conceptual gateway A/B business handoffs. Preserve IDs and document unsupported slide assumptions.
Record displayed account lifetime separately from the actual submission deadline and independently verify region/account identity without storing credentials.

Inspect actual reference source before assuming a framework: reference-agent docs describe plain Python, setup text calls it Strands, while the custom-agent module is Strands. Record the actual source as the implementation authority.

Record TMF639 Projected=False as a documented possibility caused by egress port8639. Use authoritative CR phase for resource deployment state while retaining the registry-projection gap; conditions may lag about2minutes.

The actual workshop places all three supplied reference agents in AgentCore Runtime. Treat earlier ServiceNow-customer/AWS-IT/AWS-network zone labels as logical roles, not evidence of three different deployed hosting platforms.
done_when: Every original M01 component maps to a documented asset, a runtime probe still to execute, or an explicit absent/unverified capability.
The starter files and registry/endpoint discovery paths are catalogued; no supplied platform is scheduled for rebuilding.
Documented topology and operator lifecycle are distinguished from runtime verification.
Actual CR kinds are ModelConfig, ToolConfig and AgentConfig in oda.tmforum.org/v1beta1; a governed model alias is a ModelConfig field/value, not a separate ModelConfigAlias kind.
risk: The workshop is materially different from the initial schematic; matching names alone can attach controls to the wrong gateway.

title: Use the documented AgentConfig deployment path and separate operator approval
technology: DOCUMENTED: new-agent.sh copies the custom template, builds ARM64 through CodeBuild into ECR, then generates/applies AgentConfig in Reviewing. Legitimate approval/attestation precedes operator provisioning of AgentCore Runtime. ToolConfig supplies permitted tools; direct AgentCore creation and IAM writes are prohibited.
steps: Inspect the build-agent flow and supplied project layout; plan the investigator inside the permitted AgentConfig runtime.

Follow new-agent.sh -> CodeBuild/ECR -> generated/applied AgentConfig -> legitimate review/approval -> operator-provisioned AgentCore Runtime; inspect the script first and retain image digest/generation/readiness evidence. No new IAM roles or direct Runtime creation.
Record platform operator approval as a deployment gate separate from control decisions, human alert response and ServiceNow approval.
Plan required approval annotations and attestation as future user/team actions through the documented operator path; no approval is already completed by reading this plan.
done_when: The agent/runtime build and approval path references actual documented resources and required status checks.
Team code fits the starter rather than a new platform/service fleet.
Deployment remains PLANNED until separately authorized and exercised.
Actual required policy names/status are checked dynamically. Do not hardcode the older four-policy count because the later ceiling policy adds another required policy.
risk: Direct AWS creation calls can bypass the operator contract and fail permission boundaries.

title: Bind team identities and configure scoped access
technology: DOCUMENTED: team agent JWT/API-key credentials identify gateway callers; team-* Lambda and DynamoDB permissions are documented. No IAM writes, direct Bedrock invocation or direct AgentCore creation.
steps: Inspect the gateway credential guide and issuer/audience/team identity fields without copying secrets into prompts or evidence.
Bind team/agent identity from verified credential context; distinguish a team name header from authenticated scope.
Plan positive/negative source, gateway, registry and submission-bucket permission probes and safe credential-expiry handling within documented boundaries.
Do not assume the fixed PDP exposes per-agent identity. Team/agent credentials, host provenance and policy input attributes are distinct; use only documented actual attributes for authorization.
done_when: A permitted read succeeds and an unauthorized scoped access is denied without leaking record existence.
Credentials are absent from source, logs and exported fixtures.
Team prefixes are treated as names, not proof of tenant isolation.
risk: Shared workshop accounts can appear isolated while readers, caches or exports remain overbroad.

title: Resolve the ServiceNow requirement conflict before assuming an AICT connector
technology: DOCUMENTED CONFLICT: the ServiceNow guide describes a facilitator-enabled optional connector, absent by default, and escalate-to-incident as stretch; the earlier transcript says AICT/human loop is mandatory.
steps: Record both source statements precisely and prepare an organizer clarification on which requirement applies to this event/account; no external message is sent by this plan.
Read the ServiceNow guide independently of AWS compute work and determine whether the facilitator has enabled any connector/instance for this team.

If enabled, inventory actual asset, trace, finding, named-owner and response readback capabilities separately. If waived/absent, record the official resolution and permitted governance route rather than fabricate ServiceNow access.
done_when: The discrepancy has an authoritative documented resolution and a dated capability state.
Any connector claimed present has actual endpoint/permission evidence; guide existence does not count as connection verification.
The downstream governance route and release requirement reflect the organizer decision.
risk: Implementing an unavailable ServiceNow API or silently waiving a mandatory transcript requirement can invalidate the plan.

title: Prove approved Nemotron Nano9B through the supplied inference gateway
technology: DOCUMENTED: OpenAI-style POST /v1/chat/completions through modaas-agw port8081 using the governed alias from ModelConfig. nemotron-nano-9b maps to nvidia.nemotron-nano-9b-v2; nemotron-nano-3-30b maps to nvidia.nemotron-nano-3-30b; baseline nemotron-super-120b maps to nvidia.nemotron-super-3-120b. Direct Bedrock invocation is prohibited.
steps: Resolve the documented alias/endpoint/credential and verify current approval/attestation/readiness; prefer nemotron-nano-9b for the first investigator benchmark. Try supported Nano30B only when current access permits it and measured quality needs justify it; Super120B is the documented reference baseline, not automatically ready. No unprovided Lightning endpoint.
Plan one minimal authorized model call through the supplied gateway; record request/response, actual alias/model metadata, modaas.run_id/action_id/trace_id and reported tokens/cost.

Test structured-output capability, output limits and content-filter handling. A blocked response can be HTTP200 with finish_reason=content_filter and zero usage; status code alone does not prove success.
Record nemotron-super-120b-helper bootstrap calls separately but include them in the documented account-wide ceiling; alias inventory is not actual model execution proof.

Guide pages conflict about which aliases are preapproved. Read the current ModelConfig approval/attestation, dependency and runtime/route state for every selected alias, including helper,9B,30B andSuper. Follow the actual legitimate review path if required; no fixed bootstrap-versus-participant split is assumed.
done_when: A later real gateway invocation demonstrates the approved route with safe provenance and no credential leakage.
The current plan says DOCUMENTED, not runtime verified, until that probe executes.
Parser distinguishes usable completion, content filtering, denial, timeout and uncertain charge.
risk: The documented alias/route may expose different capabilities than a public Nemotron endpoint; HTTP200 can still be a guardrail block.

title: Extend the starter evaluator and helpers as one package
technology: DOCUMENTED BASE: ~/starter/register.yaml, evaluate.py, pull-evidence.sh, gap-list.md, run-ids.txt and submit.sh. PROPOSED TEAM EXTENSION: shared Python helpers imported by evaluate.py and the AgentConfig investigator.
steps: Inspect supplied evaluator inputs/output and preserve the starter entry points expected by the workshop.
Add small shared modules for schemas, reconciliation, controls, validation and query only where the starter lacks them; avoid a greenfield service scaffold.
Pin package/configuration versions and document build/run commands for the supplied runtime and submission flow.
done_when: Existing starter behavior is understood and retained where correct.
Team additions have a single shared schema/evaluator implementation and clear entry points.
No starter template or documentation-only extension is labelled implemented.
risk: Separate ad hoc notebooks/scripts can silently diverge on IDs, thresholds and arithmetic.

title: Define canonical schemas and retry identities
technology: DOCUMENTED INPUT FIELDS: modaas.run_id, action_id and trace_id in gateway evidence; audit-store correlation_id; CR status.registryRecordId and governance.approvals. PROPOSED: canonical versioned team schemas with explicit cross-source correlation.
steps: Map each actual source field into distinct canonical run/action/attempt/execution/observation identities; do not assume action_id proves exactly one model execution.
Bind AgentConfig, ToolConfig and ModelConfig CR/registry records and approval evidence by exact IDs and source versions; preserve the governed model alias as a separate field.
Retain duplicate, missing and conflicting identifier mappings; document source namespace and retry semantics from observed payloads.
done_when: Fixtures cover duplicate delivery, hidden retries and execution IDs reused across source namespaces.
Every persisted type has schema version, team and provenance fields.
Actual executions cannot be erased by deduplicating only on attempt ID.
A ModelConfig alias, registry asset ID, deployment CR UID and provider execution ID remain separate typed fields.
risk: Conflating an attempted call, actual provider execution and observation undercounts usage.

title: Implement authoritative lifecycle and execution correlation
technology: DOCUMENTED SOURCES: audit-store timeline/records by correlation_id, gateway correlation fields, AgentCore traces and CR/registry records. PROPOSED lifecycle interpretation must match observed source finality.
steps: Map authoritative lifecycle events from the starter/source timeline into OPEN, ACTIONS_CLOSED and EVIDENCE_FINAL, retaining unknown transition authority.
Correlate run/action/trace/correlation IDs using explicit relations, preserving unmatched executions and conflicting run assignments.
Keep operator deployment approval distinct from a business run opening or assurance finalization.

A pause is an eventually propagated runtime condition: the guide observed roughly15seconds to stop and50seconds to resume. Observe actual effect and preserve in-flight work; do not assert instant physical no-send from a pause request.
done_when: Closing actions does not discard late usage or imply source finality.
A provider execution claimed by two runs is retained as a conflict, not charged twice.
Evidence finalization records either satisfied completion rules or explicit gaps.
risk: Local lifecycle state does not prove upstream dispatch stopped without an actual supported hook.

title: Freeze dated thresholds, measurement definitions and owners
technology: DOCUMENTED BASE: ~/starter/register.yaml plus workshop control briefs. PROPOSED declared rules: C7 event evidence, C9 per-runtime hourly AgentCore Latency/Errors, and C16 per-run token cap.
steps: Extend register.yaml with dated owner, metric, comparison direction, units/statistic, threshold, allowance, source authority and measurement population.

For C9 freeze AgentCore Latency statistic Average in milliseconds and Errors statistic Sum as count for each runtime in one clock-hour windows. Preserve namespace, complete dimensions, period, units, timestamps, region, start/end and source/query status before comparison; score-run.py is a separate diagnosis grade.
For C16 choose and justify a per-run cap independently of the documented account quotas100RPM and2.5million tokens/hour; those quotas are not a run budget.
Version and preserve baseline/policy/configuration before executing assessed runs.

Freeze each applicable control rule and its baseline/treatment acquisition protocol before any assessed run/window. Any permitted pre-freeze exploratory/calibration case is labelled exploratory and excluded from submitted assessed evidence unless organizers explicitly accept another declared provenance.
done_when: Every claimed control has an explicit immutable rule and accepted evidence basis.
C9 metric normalization/statistic/direction, window closure and zero-baseline/error handling are declared before use.
Account quotas cannot be substituted for a per-run threshold and later observed outcomes cannot choose the rule.
risk: Choosing thresholds or denominators after seeing outcomes invalidates pass/breach demonstrations.

title: Load pinned policy and explicit action-to-control mappings
technology: DOCUMENTED: starter register; narrow Module6 Cedar exception permits team policy ConfigMap in modaas-system with app.kubernetes.io/part-of=modaas-pdp label and policy-id annotation. Fixed PDP/gateway code is not editable, and per-agent identity is not exposed to policy. PROPOSED control applicability remains separate.
steps: Map model inference to C16 accounting/C7 records, tool/runtime evidence to declared C7 scope, and hourly AgentCore metrics to C9.
Load the immutable starter register outside the inference path; pin scope/spec/configuration versions to assessed runs/windows.
Document Cedar enforcement as supplied authorization behavior, not our custom token admission hook. Keep operator approvals and finding/human-response decisions separate.
Inspect actual required Cedar/policy names and readiness, including the later modaas-ceiling policy, instead of enforcing the older four-policy count. Keep policy/condition propagation lag visible.

Apply only the documented team Cedar ConfigMap scope; this is a narrow authorized exception to protected-namespace rules, not blanket shared-platform write permission or an automatic new approval blocker.

Inspect route policy composition: a permit/unless toolName check may permit a missing toolName or be overridden by another applicable permit. Constrain the shared AgentCore Gateway route to declared tool names, testing absent/unknown names and all applicable policies; use supported explicit-forbid semantics where needed.
done_when: Unmatched in-scope actions appear as mapping gaps.
Historical assessments load their original exact rule after later policy changes.
Updating a bundle cannot reset an existing run's spend or silently replace a frozen C9 baseline.
The effective route decision is tested for declared, undeclared and missing toolName across composed policies; a template text alone is not proof of restriction.
risk: A single expiry timestamp used for all purposes can incorrectly stop valid work or rewrite historical results.

title: Implement raw and canonical repositories with a portable local path
technology: DOCUMENTED PERMISSIONS: workshop IDE host may use team-output files/SQLite and documented team-* tables/Lambda; component pods have no ambient AWS credentials/public-S3 egress. PROPOSED FIRST STORE: IDE-host SQLite plus immutable team-output files, with persistence/restart tests before relying on it.
steps: Inspect the starter and reuse IDE-host team-output files plus SQLite for normalization/query. Confirm actual host persistence and restart behavior rather than assuming a container filesystem is durable.
Keep captured sources, facts, candidates, bindings and cases versioned and locally resolvable; stage only permitted team outputs for the IDE-side submission helper.

Do not use the IDE role as proof that EKS component pods or an AgentCore process can call DynamoDB/S3. Add a cloud store only with verified execution identity, network path and an actual shared-state need; no local SQLite distributed-admission claim.
done_when: A raw capture and corresponding canonical record survive restart and remain addressable by version.
Malformed/unmatched inputs can be retained without fabricating valid facts.
Repository choice and concurrency guarantees are documented.
IDE host permissions, AgentConfig Runtime access and component-pod access are recorded independently; missing credentials/egress remain real boundaries.
risk: Mutable overwrite or unversioned references make prior answers impossible to reproduce.

title: Extend pull-evidence.sh across the documented evidence surfaces
technology: DOCUMENTED: TMF639 v5 inventory; CR approval/registry fields; modaas-agw and modaas-pdp logs; audit-store port8080 /timeline?cid= and /records?cid= JSONL; /modaas/evidence CloudWatch; AgentCore CloudWatch OTEL spans. The collector trace pipeline has no durable exporter, so X-Ray/cockpit Trace may be empty.
steps: Inspect and extend ~/starter/pull-evidence.sh instead of replacing it with a new ingestion service.

Read registry assets/CR status.governance.approvals and status.registryRecordId; collect gateway token/cost/correlation fields, Cedar decisions, audit timeline/JSONL, CloudWatch evidence and relevant AgentCore spans.
Resolve endpoints through status.endpoint; document authentication, paging/filter/retention and capture semantics per surface.
Preserve recoverable scoped captures before durable receipt/checkpoint; expose failed pages and incomplete sources.

Use gateway/PDP/CloudWatch evidence and AgentCore CloudWatch spans as documented durable sources. Do not promise X-Ray or cockpit Trace completeness from the broad services overview; record missing collector export explicitly.

When TMF639 projection fails, preserve CR captures and the explicit registry gap. Authoritative CR phase can establish resource state while lagging conditions or Projected=False cannot establish registry completeness.
done_when: Every selected source has a tested reader or an explicit source gap; nothing is inferred from the starter filename alone.
A captured run can be followed across registry/runtime/gateway/audit evidence using exact IDs.
Collection completeness and upstream execution completeness remain separate.
risk: Different stores can contain correlated copies of the same event or usage; pulling all of them must not double-count.

title: Add the ServiceNow reader only if the facilitator route is enabled
technology: DOCUMENTED OPTIONAL SURFACE: facilitator-enabled ServiceNow connector; no default access or exact table assumed.
steps: Wait for T04 requirement/capability resolution; inspect actual supplied connector schema before implementing a reader.
If enabled, capture permitted asset/incident/response records with actor, source version and generated provenance.
If absent or officially waived, leave this reader unimplemented and expose the actual governance evidence route; do not invent notes or human responses.
done_when: A real permitted record is retrievable by stable captured reference.
Generated notes are not treated as independent corroboration.
Missing read permission remains a visible response/evidence gap.
An authoritative waiver/approved alternative may resolve this task scope, but must not be labelled a working ServiceNow reader/delivery/human-response integration.
risk: ServiceNow documentation is optional in this event guide; a fictional connector would corrupt architecture and evidence claims.
conditional_gate: If T04 establishes an authoritative event-specific waiver/approved alternative, close this branch as WAIVED_OR_REPLACED with that source and no runtime-delivery claim. If the integration remains mandatory and unavailable, retain ACCESS_BLOCKED. Runtime acceptance criteria below apply only when the corresponding route is enabled.

title: Build independent expected-work and source-authority manifests
technology: DOCUMENTED CANDIDATES: registered resources/CRs, scenario/run-reference manifests, audit timeline and AgentCore runtime/hour metric dimensions. Source authority/completeness still needs runtime tests.
steps: Define independent expected agents/actions/event slots and runtime/hour windows from the accepted run/scenario/configuration authority, not surviving telemetry alone.
Treat registry inventory as resource inventory, not automatically the complete model-execution ledger; identify the additional execution/run finality evidence.
Freeze C9 expected hourly windows/runtimes and permitted metric dimensions; preserve no-traffic, missing metric and collection lag separately.

Neither a partially projected TMF639 inventory nor an empty cockpit Trace is a complete expected-work ledger. Preserve independent declared run/runtime populations and unresolved projection/export gaps.
done_when: Removing an observed event does not remove its independent expected obligation.
A wholly missing stream/window can be represented and queried.
No control claims a complete population solely from what was collected.
risk: Unavailable independent populations may block completion of an affected control scope.

title: Parse and reconcile duplicates, conflicts, corrections and freshness
technology: DOCUMENTED: gateway input/output token and cost fields plus modaas IDs; audit/CloudWatch/OTEL correlated records; Cedar permit/deny and guardrail content-filter outcomes.
steps: Normalize actual gateway usage/cost schema, units and source namespace; never add duplicate OTEL/audit/log copies or parent totals again.
Parse HTTP200 content_filter/zero-usage blocks and Cedar denials distinctly from successful inference; preserve uncertain charged executions.
Reconcile late corrections, hidden retries and changed source content; keep field authority and completeness explicit.
Normalize quota HTTP429 with source-supported zero-charge evidence separately from provider unknown outcomes. Do not assume every429 from every layer is free without the documented provenance.
done_when: A corrected total replaces the accepted previous total instead of adding to it.
Duplicate observations do not multiply an execution charge.
Collection lag, missing source, unusable field and conflicting authority remain separate states.
risk: Incorrect cumulative counter semantics can produce plausible but false cost totals.

title: Store evidence bindings, model proposals and versioned cases
technology: DOCUMENTED BASE: registry IDs, captured starter evidence and team output storage. PROPOSED: typed JSONL/tables for exact fact/control/spec/scope bindings, candidates and cases; no graph service.
steps: Represent many-to-many fact/control/spec/scope bindings with exact record revisions.
Store candidate model assertions separately from accepted facts.
Persist assessment and case manifests only with resolvable required inputs or explicit gaps.
done_when: One usage fact supports multiple controls without multiplying accounting rows.
Candidate extraction cannot enter authoritative calculations before validation.
Partial writes remain pending; published cases reference coherent durable versions.
risk: Fan-out joins and silent proposal promotion corrupt both arithmetic and explainability.

title: Build exact-scope retrieval and bounded narrative context selection
technology: DOCUMENTED BASE: starter evidence capture and audit-store correlation reads. PROPOSED: exact team-output indexes and bounded narrative context selection; no new search/vector platform.
steps: Retrieve complete available obligations, records, unmatched inputs and gaps for a pinned scope.
Expose index lag, page limits and unavailable references.
Rank narrative excerpts for context without using top-k retrieval as the control denominator.
done_when: A scope lookup returns explicit coverage metadata with the requested revision.
Records without an existing control binding remain discoverable.
Context truncation is disclosed independently of structured-evidence completeness.
risk: Semantic retrieval can omit decisive records if reused as the evidence population.

title: Adapt supplied model/MCP/audit evidence rather than install custom gateway code
technology: DOCUMENTED: modaas-agw inference port8081, AgentCore Gateway MCP /mcp/<alias> port8080, ToolConfig Lambda and audit evidence. The shared inference gateway exposes Cedar ConfigMap policy, not arbitrary inline team code.
steps: Translate observed model calls, MCP tool calls and declared handoff/runtime records into shared emit/pull contracts.
Implement team observation code in the permitted AgentConfig agent or team tool where needed; reuse gateway logs for evidence.
Capture one run through the real documented path and label observation versus supplied Cedar authorization honestly. Do not deploy an imagined synchronous token-control plugin.

For any added MCP tool, declare its exact permitted name and validate the shared route policy across existing permits, absent toolName and undeclared names. Per-agent isolation cannot be claimed from unavailable PDP identity attributes.
done_when: Real source records bind the selected model and tool/runtime boundaries to canonical IDs.
Every boundary diagram names the actual product and supported extension surface.
Custom gateway-inline enforcement is absent from core implementation claims.
risk: A tool gateway does not observe every model call; Cedar authorization is not token metering.

title: Implement C16 whole-run actual token accounting first
technology: DOCUMENTED: control16 brief and modaas-agw input/outputtokens/cost with run/action/trace correlation. PROPOSED: extend starter evaluate.py for actual whole-run accounting.
steps: Extend the supplied evaluator to collect all governed agent/model executions for the selected run, including actual retries when observable.
Declare the precise token fields and non-overlap/dedup rules before summation; show reported cost separately and retain missing execution/finality gaps.
Compare actual whole-run tokens to the dated chosen per-run cap. Treat100RPM and2.5million tokens/hour as shared account quotas, never the run cap.
done_when: Named accepted pass/breach cases reproduce their actual totals from captured gateway inputs.
A trusted scoped subtotal over the cap proves breach; incomplete under-cap evidence remains indeterminate.
No reservation estimate or duplicate audit/span copy is charged as extra actual usage.
risk: Provider usage may omit hidden retries or finality, blocking reliable under-cap satisfaction.

title: Validate extraction schemas, spans, scope and authority
technology: DOCUMENTED BASE: immutable captured workshop evidence and starter control outputs. PROPOSED: host-side validation/revision/composition helpers inside the same team package, not a second LLM truth service.
steps: Check exact source/span/version and normalization mappings for each proposal.
Reauthorize both ends of every relation and validate permitted scope/type.
Separate VERIFIED source quote, verified relation and operational fact; require declared authority/corroboration for the precise assertion.
done_when: A valid quote with wrong meaning or negation cannot support an operational claim.
Similar incident names and forged IDs cannot create verified cross-run/team links.
REJECTED proposal means failed validation, not proof the underlying world claim is false.
risk: Exact text occurrence alone cannot establish entailment or source truth.

title: Manage accepted revisions and invalidate affected assessments
technology: DOCUMENTED BASE: immutable captured workshop evidence and starter control outputs. PROPOSED: host-side validation/revision/composition helpers inside the same team package, not a second LLM truth service.
steps: Promote validated candidates atomically against their base revision; revalidate conflicts.
Track dependencies from inputs to runs/windows/populations/claims/caches and recompute only affected branches.
Preserve historical assertions and explicit baseline restatements; distinguish authority changes from access revocation.
done_when: Concurrent corrections cannot publish mixed old/new accepted facts.
A parser/link correction can invalidate cases even when raw bytes are unchanged.
Frozen baseline corrections retain the original dated basis and explicit restatement.
risk: Stale cache or partial dependency invalidation can present an invalid proof as current.

title: Implement C7 event coverage and valid timing-pair evaluation
technology: DOCUMENTED: CR governance.approvals and registry IDs, PDP/Cedar logs, audit timeline, CloudWatch /modaas/evidence and AgentCore CloudWatch OTEL spans. PROPOSED: extend evaluate.py for declared C7 event coverage/timing.
steps: Choose the exact approved C7 event scope and independent expected sequence from the real run/operator/tool lifecycle; do not automatically count deployment approvals as business run events.
Match each expected event and preserve missing adjacent pairs; check actual source clock/epoch/precision before interval arithmetic.
Apply the dated limit/allowance in register.yaml and return exact supporting records plus source/collection gaps.
Record trace-export and registry-projection gaps instead of declaring complete C7 because the remaining durable sources contain some events.
done_when: Each required event type has a documented source mapping and observed or missing state.
Source clocks unsuitable for the claimed timing metric yield an explicit limitation rather than fabricated millisecond precision.
The original illustrative arithmetic remains a fixture, not a measured workshop result.
risk: Cross-agent timestamps may not share an eligible clock, restricting meaningful timing assertions.

title: Freeze the C9 AgentCore metric manifest and baseline by runtime/hour
technology: DOCUMENTED C9 CONTRACT: AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore metrics with exact Name, Operation and Resource dimensions; Latency Average milliseconds and Errors Sum count, period3600seconds in closed UTC clock-hour windows. score-run.py remains separate diagnostic grading.
steps: Replace the earlier scenario-accuracy C9 basis with the documented operational metrics: Latency Average milliseconds and Errors Sum count, evaluated per runtime over declared one clock-hour windows.

Capture namespace AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore, exact Name/Operation/Resource dimension values and runtime identity, metric name, statistic, unit, period3600seconds, region, closed UTC start/end and returned timestamps. Do not use a values-only response or a partial dimension set.

Freeze a complete comparable baseline before assessed windows; preserve runtime/model/prompt/tool versions and traffic/eligibility rules. Define explicit minimum coverage and closed-window/late-data conditions.

Use a declared relative-increase rule only with a positive latency baseline. For an Errors baseline of zero use a predeclared absolute count rule; an error rate is an alternative only with a declared valid invocation denominator, not the default Errors Sum metric.
Keep scenario outcomes/labels and score-run.py grades in a separate diagnostic-quality manifest.

Begin declared baseline capture into preserved team-output files as soon as the initial collection gate passes; do not wait for the full proposal/case repository in T16. Bind the captured baseline into that repository when ready, preserving original timestamps and policy version.
done_when: The C9 register pins AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore, complete Name/Operation/Resource series identity, Latency Average milliseconds and Errors Sum count with closed UTC one-hour boundaries.
Baseline and assessed windows meet frozen closure/coverage/comparability rules; missing datapoints and no eligible traffic are not silently converted to measured zero.
Pagination/completeness and source availability lag are captured before a window is considered final.
A zero baseline cannot enter a relative division; the predeclared alternative rule is reproducible.
risk: Latency statistics, error counts and error rates are not interchangeable; zero baseline or missing hourly data can invalidate a relative comparison.

title: Evaluate C9 hourly runtime drift with declared direction and coverage
technology: DOCUMENTED: AgentCore Latency Average milliseconds and Errors Sum count per runtime, one clock-hour. PROPOSED deterministic C9 evaluator in starter evaluate.py.
steps: Register the full expected runtime/closed-UTC-hour population and fetch every required datapoint/page for AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore with exact Name/Operation/Resource dimensions, statistic, period3600seconds, unit, region and timestamps.
Assess only windows closed under the frozen clock-hour boundary, source-lag and coverage contract. Partial/current hours or missing pages remain provisional/unknown, not passing.

Compare compatible versions/traffic populations with declared worsening direction and exact unrounded arithmetic; never average per-runtime averages into an aggregate without valid weights and an explicitly different scope.
Handle duplicate/revised datapoints by authoritative identity/revision; preserve old answers and restate affected assessments.
Apply interval allowance separately and create an alert for every measured crossing; keep missing/no-traffic/incompatible windows explicit.
done_when: Known fixtures reproduce exact Latency Average/Errors Sum boundary outcomes with all required dimensions/units preserved.
Wrong-unit, wrong-statistic, partial-hour, missing-page, duplicate/revised-data and zero-baseline fixtures cannot falsely pass.
Crossing alerts retain runtime/hour/spec/input references independently of aggregate tolerance.
risk: A changing model/configuration or traffic mix can make two hourly metrics incomparable; measurement and explanation must disclose that scope.

title: Create local measured findings and resolve the authorized external governance route
technology: DOCUMENTED CONFLICT: facilitator ServiceNow connector is optional/default absent; deterministic local findings can be produced from starter assessments while organizer clarification is pending.
steps: Create durable local C16 findings first with exact control/spec/run/assessment, dated owner and cited evidence; extend to each C9 measured hourly crossing after T24.
Keep local intent distinct from external delivery. Gate all remote routing on T04 organizer resolution and actual permitted connector/workflow capability.
Use immutable mutation/content/recipient revisions; optional Nemotron explanation cannot choose recipients, authorize sends or replace measured verdicts.
done_when: Local findings can be inspected while the remote-route question remains honestly blocked.
The accepted external governance route is named by source and no unavailable ServiceNow integration is implied.
Every measured C9 crossing retains its obligation and evidence regardless of aggregate allowance.
risk: Idempotency keyed only by assessment revision can lose later route/content changes.

title: Deliver findings with bounded retries and verified remote readback
technology: DOCUMENTED: ServiceNow connector/workflow is conditional on facilitator enablement and event requirement clarification. PROPOSED outbox/readback applies only to the actual authorized route.
steps: Do not execute external writes until T04 resolves the event requirement and the user authorizes the concrete integration; if officially waived, preserve the waiver and do not pretend remote delivery happened.
Persist intent/outbox consistently or recover via explicit durable sweep.
Check intent validity/supersession before conditional dispatch claim; reconcile uncertain writes without blind repeated creates.
Read back target instance, correlation, intended mutation revision/content and named-recipient route; bound attempts and expose terminal gaps.
done_when: Lost acknowledgement becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until reconciled.
Remote ID or HTTP202 alone cannot mark intended content/recipient delivered.
Stale updates cannot silently overwrite accepted corrections; unsupported safe remote ordering remains unresolved.
An authoritative waiver/approved alternative may resolve this task scope, but must not be labelled a working ServiceNow reader/delivery/human-response integration.
risk: No remote ServiceNow delivery may be claimed while the connector is absent or the obligation is unresolved; local intent is not a substitute.
conditional_gate: If T04 establishes an authoritative event-specific waiver/approved alternative, close this branch as WAIVED_OR_REPLACED with that source and no runtime-delivery claim. If the integration remains mandatory and unavailable, retain ACCESS_BLOCKED. Runtime acceptance criteria below apply only when the corresponding route is enabled.

title: Track human response, remediation and passing retests honestly
technology: DOCUMENTED CONDITIONAL ROUTE: facilitator ServiceNow integration; operator governance approval is separately documented and cannot stand in for an end-user alert response.
steps: Apply the organizer-approved human-loop requirement from T04; deployment/operator approvals are separate evidence and do not prove a human received or answered a measured-control alert.
